subject: Request: latest penetration test package for Hosted API & secure review options
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest PT package and secure transfer options

Hi Evelyn,

We're updating our SIG questionnaire and need the latest penetration test report and remediation evidence for Redwood's Hosted API. Specifically we need:

- The most recent full report (technical) and an exec summary for leadership.
- Clarification on scope: does the report cover the hosted API control plane, customer data stores, and any shared caching layers?
- A remediation tracker or status (open/verified/fixed) for high and critical findings.
- Your preferred secure transfer method (we can accept presigned S3 links, a secure review portal, or encrypted archives over an SFTP drop).

We have a compliance deadline next Thursday (2027-08-26). If you need an NDA or additional paperwork, let us know. Also please indicate whether you performed active exploitation during the engagement (yes/no) and whether re-testing is planned.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Security Assurance
Acme Health
liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest PT package and secure transfer options

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely get you what you need before your deadline. Quick summary and options below.

What we can provide today:
- redwood_pt_2027_exec_summary.pdf (executive summary with risk rollups)
- redwood_pt_2027_full_report.pdf.gpg (full technical report, encrypted)
- remediation_tracker_202708.csv (current remediation tracker, export from our tracker)
- SOC 2 Type II bridge letter (if helpful)

Scope clarification (short):
- Engagement covered Hosted API control plane, front-end API layer, and shared infrastructure used by Hosted customers.
- Customer-managed customer-data stores (customer-owned S3 buckets) were out of scope.
- Shared KV cache behavior was tested in the context of API session handling; tests did not access customer tenant data.

Transfer options (pick one):
1) Secure review portal (preferred): invitation-based portal, view-only, no downloads by default. Link expires after 14 days.
2) Presigned S3 download: encrypted GPG file; one-time presigned link, 7-day expiry.
3) Encrypted archive via SFTP (we can push into customer SFTP account provided by Acme).

Notes on exploitation and retest:
- Active exploitation was performed in a controlled environment by our red team (yes). No exploitation led to customer data exfiltration.
- We have a scheduled retest window (target) the week of 2027-09-06 for verified fixes; timeline depends on fix verification.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm preferred transfer option and whether you need an NDA/POC. If portal, provide the primary reviewer emails; we will send invites. If S3, we will send the presigned link and GPG passphrase via a separate channel.

Attaching: redwood_pt_2027_exec_summary.pdf (attached), remediation_tracker_202708.csv (attached). The full technical report is encrypted and available via the secure portal or presigned link.

Thanks — cc'ing Vivek (security lead) and Ben (Customer Security Enablement) for details/ops.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Compliance & GTM Security
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest PT package and secure transfer options

Thanks, Evelyn — that all sounds good. We prefer the secure review portal for the full report (view-only) and exec summary as a PDF download for our leadership. Please invite the following reviewers to the portal:

- liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com (security lead)
- priya.sharma@acmehealth.com (compliance)

A couple of follow-ups before you send:
- Can you confirm whether the test included authentication bypass scenarios against tenant-scoped endpoints (i.e., could an attacker enumerate or access another tenant's data)?
- For the remediation tracker, could you flag which fixes are pending validation vs. scheduled for re-test? We need to reflect that in our SIG answers.

If you can get the portal invite and exec summary to us today, that will keep us on schedule.

Appreciate it,
Liam

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest PT package and secure transfer options

Hi Liam — quick technical clarifications from the engagement team: 

- Tenant isolation/auth checks: the engagement included authenticated testing of tenant-scoped endpoints. No successful cross-tenant data access was achieved. There were two medium findings related to insufficient rate-limiting on an auxiliary API that could theoretically enable enumeration; both are addressed in the tracker.
- Active exploitation: enumerations and proof-of-concept authenticated attacks were performed against non-production replicas and a staging mesh that mirrors production traffic; no customer data was accessed.
- Remediation tracker status (summary):
  - Critical: 0 open
  - High: 2 open (fixes implemented; awaiting verification)
  - Medium: 4 open (two scheduled for 2027-09-02 retest, two fixed and verified)

Retest schedule: targeted retest week of 2027-09-06; we will update the tracker as verification completes. The remediation_tracker_202708.csv attached contains a "status" column with values: open/in-progress/verified/scheduled.

Portal and attachments: Evelyn will send the portal invite. We will place the encrypted PDF in the portal and also make a one-time presigned link available if you need an offline copy (we will provide the GPG passphrase over a different channel).

If you want a short phone walkthrough, I can do 20 minutes today between 1–3pm PT.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest PT package and secure transfer options

Liam — portal invite sent to liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com and priya.sharma@acmehealth.com with view-only access.

Portal details: https://secure.redwoodinference.com/review/INV-9a2b (expires 2027-09-06). The executive summary PDF is available for download; the full technical report is view-only. The remediation tracker CSV is attached to the portal entry and a CSV export was emailed to you earlier.

If you don't see the invite, check spam or let me know and I'll reissue. Vivek — we'll update SUP-1234 with the verification deadlines and tag the two high items as 'verification pending'.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Customer Security Enablement
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
